Genesis 26:25
…He pitched his tent and his servants started digging another well.
Genesis 26:32 Later that same day, Isaac’s servants came to him with news about the well they had been digging, ” We’ve struck water!”

?Those associated with you will come to you with good news.

?You have laboured and expecting good feedbacks, today, people will come to you with good news.

?You have down, expecting to reap, today, you will reap bountiful harvest.

?You will not return home tonight without good tidings in Jesus name??????
